hero_sub: Come in, relax and enjoy freshly roasted coffee, made with care. On your own or with friends.
home_intro_title: Founded in 2017 with a simple idea: coffee done right, in a space worth staying in.
home_intro_p: We're a modern specialty coffee shop. Our goal is a unique, positive experience: the best-quality coffee, freshly roasted, in a warm and minimalist space made for a good moment — on your own or in good company.
home_menu_title: From the Probat to your cup
home_menu_p: Espresso, cold brew, frappés and a case of freshly made sweets and savouries. Every drink is made by trained baristas for a perfect extraction.
home_modes_title: Stay or take it with you
home_modes_p: True to our name, there are two ways to enjoy Deux: sit down at one of our cafés, or grab your coffee at a To Go spot.
mode_dinein_p: Four cafés with modern, urban architecture to sit, work or meet friends.
mode_togo_p: Four quick spots to stop, order and be on your way — without giving up quality.
home_store_title: The freshest coffee in the city, straight to your home
home_store_p: Whole-bean coffee, drip boxes and gear to brew a specialty cup wherever you are.
home_cta_p: Message us on WhatsApp for orders, questions, or to find the location nearest you.
about_hero_title:
Quality over quantity:
every batch tasted and approved.
about_hero_p: Freshly roasted specialty coffee in a minimalist, urban and welcoming space.
about_story_p1: We were founded with one purpose: to be a modern café and offer a unique, positive experience. It starts with our commitment to the best-quality, freshly roasted coffee, paired with a welcoming space to relax and enjoy a good moment — with friends or over a great cup.
about_story_p2: A minimalist space, with modern, urban architecture, creates a unique and exclusive atmosphere across our shops.
about_coffee_p1: Grown to the highest quality standards, our Arabica beans are hand-picked and dried through a natural fermented process, revealing only beans that score above 86 points on the SCA scale.
about_coffee_p2: Our roasting is a delicate balance of time and temperature. Our baristas are trained to deliver a perfect extraction in every cup.
about_roast_p: Every batch runs through our Probat roaster, where we control the roast curve bean by bean. That's how we get the profile that reaches each of our locations.
